title: Reddit will join the S&P 500 on August 18, becoming only the second pure-play social media company in the index after Meta; RDDT jumps 10%+ after hours (Jonathan Vanian/CNBC)
summary: Jonathan Vanian / CNBC: Reddit will join the S&P 500 on August 18, becoming only the second pure-play social media company in the index after Meta; RDDT jumps 10%+ after hours — Reddit shares rose 11% in extended trading on Thursday on the social media company's inclusion in the S&P 500.
